text:
Jun: Morning — quick check: final rack-to-node mapping for the H100 batch arriving next Wed? we need to confirm which reservations we hold and who owns the final rack wiring. tagging infra + sre.

Priya: ETA update: shipping manifest says 3/27 -> customs + 2-3 days. nominal on-site ETA = 3/30. can we move a subset to canary racks on arrival?

Mateo: If we put 4 nodes in the canary pool we can validate autoscaler tweaks. I can run the canary burn. need the reservation IDs.

Sasha: @Jun can you confirm VLANs and uplink counts per rack? net asked about 40G vs 100G.

Jun: VLANs are the usual 10xxx pool. uplinks: racks A2/A3 get 2x100G, others 2x40G. see mapping below.

Jun:
```
rack A2: 8 nodes -> 2x100G uplink -> reservation RES-8421 (canary)
rack A3: 8 nodes -> 2x100G uplink -> reservation RES-8422
rack B1: 12 nodes -> 2x40G uplink -> reservation RES-8423
```

Nadia: Oncall: I'll prebook firewall windows. want the drop-in time window? prefer midnight-0300 PST.

Priya: Shipping said partial pallet might arrive earlier. I'll add a temporary hold for RES-8421/8422 so they aren't auto-released.

ops-bot: Reservation RES-8421 created by @Priya — expires in 72h unless claimed.

Mateo: quick ask — pinging eng-runtime for a CR: can someone review the autoscaler change? small tweak in autoscaler config (scaleDownDelay -> 30s). PR: https://git.internal/rw/autoscaler/pull/412

Sasha: I can take the CR first pass today. also will coordinate with SRE on uplink test.

Jun: OK, plan: 1) Priya keeps holds on RES-8421/8422 2) Sasha runs uplink precheck 3) Mateo runs canary with 4 nodes 4) Nadia schedules firewall midnight window 5) I'll post final manifest and handoff checklist when manifest is updated. :thumbsup:

Priya: added note in the tracker: https://docs.internal/rw/procurement/gpu-buildout-tracker — row RES-8421/8422 flagged.

Mateo: I'll try to run canary on Thu night. will update with metrics (latency, token/sec). if infra ok, we'll roll the rest Friday.

Jun: awesome. flagging @ops-team for any last-minute power/circuit constraints.

Sasha: noted. I'll post test logs in this thread.

Nadia: scheduled firewall change for 03/31 00:00-03:00 PST. :lock:

Jun: thanks everyone — if no further blockers I'll close the loop by EOD.
